instruction: Configure Rhythmbox to be the default music player on your Ubuntu system.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Rhythmbox as the default audio/music player on Ubuntu. The evaluator uses a custom getter that queries xdg-mime for all common audio MIME types (mp3, flac, ogg, wav, etc.) and returns the most common default application. The metric checks if the result includes 'rhythmbox.desktop'. This task is similar in difficulty and complexity to the original VLC task, requiring the same type of system configuration change.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts the default audio player by querying xdg-mime for multiple audio MIME types and returning the most common default application
Metric correctly checks if the result contains 'rhythmbox.desktop' using include/exclude pattern
Expected value 'rhythmbox.desktop' is semantically correct for verifying Rhythmbox as default audio player on Ubuntu
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the single requirement in the instruction
Edge cases handled appropriately: returns 'unknown' when no default is set, handles multiple MIME types correctly
